The background features red brick buildings and lush green trees under bright daylight. (2) The scene cuts rapidly through a series of fashion-oriented poses. (5) The final phases show the couple in an outdoor plaza, on the steps of a grey building, and a extreme low-angle 'worm's-eye view' shot looking up at their faces against a clear blue sky. The editing is highly rhythmic, featuring quick jump cuts that synchronize with the musical pulses.
